$comment: The six guest-facing event groups (Donald 6.10.26). Names use pluses, never ampersands. Finer keys stay STORED and fold on READ — so a split can come back by editing the fold map, no migration. Editors write only the six. The category replaces the weekday hue on EVENT UI; the day-code stays for posters, print and non-event surfaces. A deal (Happy Hour) is yellow's JOB, not a category.

groups.name: Games + Social
groups.holds: games, trivia, pub quiz, board games, social + community, parties, drinks nights

groups.name: Arts, Film, Music
groups.holds: creative arts, film + screenings, music, dance, performance

groups.name: Talk Events
groups.holds: language exchange, conversation, talks, discussions, Walkabout

groups.name: Wellness
groups.nameViLong: Sống khoẻ + Phát triển bản thân

deal.$comment: Happy Hour and drink deals: yellow by JOB, found by title — never a seventh category.
